history.label: Hybrid AP-Hunter
history.rationale: Nidalee Q scales AP heavily (~70%); cougar form benefits from on-hit + AD. Lich Bane + Nashor's creates a hybrid burst-poke pattern that punishes both ranged poke AND cougar dives.
